title: Lumbar
summary: LUM'BAR, adjective [Latin lumbus, loins.] Pertaining to the loins. The lumbar region is the posterior portion of the body between the false ribs and the upper edge of the haunch bone.

inlines.v: LUM'BAR, adjective [Latin lumbus, loins.] Pertaining to the loins. The lumbar region is the posterior portion of the body between the false ribs and the upper edge of the haunch bone.
